main_concerns.concern: The design proposal describes the right shape (contract + four sample classes + aggregate check + Prism-reviewed threshold changes) but omits the concrete contents that would make it a real measurement. Without specified sample definitions, threshold values, and trend computation rules, implementation can easily become a metrics theater that produces passing reports without measuring actual hook behavior.
样本集自建无独立验证：hook-quality 的度量可信度完全依赖样本标签的准确性。如果样本由 Hook 运行方自行标注，度量回路就变成了自证预言——Hook 说什么是误伤就是误伤，说什么不是就不是。设计方案未要求样本标注方独立于 Hook 实现方，也未定义标注争议仲裁机制，这使持续度量退化为持续自我背书的风险很高。

minimum_fixes.minimum_fix: Before writing runtime code, produce a draft contract with at least one concrete sample per class, explicit threshold values and their derivation, a precise trend rule (window + failure condition), and a documented sample refresh cadence from real hook events. Require a Prism re-review of that draft before implementation begins.

在 hook-quality-metrics.json 合同中增加样本治理条款：(1) 样本标注必须由独立于 Hook 日常运行的 Prism 评审确认，至少对新增和变更样本执行抽查标记；(2) 定义最小样本量下限（建议每类 ≥10）和样本新鲜度检查（最近 N 天内必须有新样本），跌破下限时报告 degraded 而非 healthy；(3) 阈值变更必须通过独立的合同变更流程而非仅标记字段，建议在 redcap 自检中增加合同签名校验，检测未签审的阈值改动。此外，在实现 hook_quality_metrics.py 时必须包含至少 2 个负向测试：一个确认 FP 样本回放失败会导致 overall=fail，一个确认 FN 高风险样本回放失败会导致 overall=fail。
